prompt: Design REST API endpoints for a blog platform with users, posts, and comments. Show the URL structure, HTTP methods, and example request/response for creating a new post.

assertions.name: proper_http_methods
assertions.description: GET for read, POST for create, PUT/PATCH for update, DELETE for delete

assertions.name: uuid_ids
assertions.description: Uses UUID format for resource IDs

assertions.name: iso8601_timestamps
assertions.description: Includes created_at/updated_at in ISO8601 UTC format

assertions.name: status_201_on_create
assertions.description: Returns 201 status code for resource creation

assertions.name: nested_foreign_keys
assertions.description: Uses nested objects for foreign key relations (e.g. author: {id} not author_id)

assertions.name: structured_error_format
assertions.description: Error responses include id, message, and optional url fields
